Video.summary: Willi and Chris are back in New Mexico, bowhunting elk. Willi made a poor shot on a bull, and after discovering the cause of the poor shot, he hopes to get redemption as their hunting days come to a close.
Video.title: "New Mexico Elk Redemption"

Video.summary: In part 1 of the British episodes, Andy starts his road trip around the United Kingdom in the Cotswolds where he sets out to hunt and taste the beautiful venison that Michelin star chef, Mark Robinson has to offer. He then proceeds to travel to the border of Scotland where he samples some of the finest and most historic bird shooting practices found throughout the British Isles.
Video.title: Wildbound - "UK Part 1"

Video.summary: South Africa offers an incredible insight into the hunter and gatherer history of ancestors. Dan Cabela re-traces the footsteps of humanity's forefathers and explores how modern, private ownership of land has helped re-balance the human relationship with nature.
Video.title: "The hunting heritage of South Africa"

Video.summary: Trenton makes a trip to Louisiana to fish with Theophile Bourgeois at the Cajun Vista Lodge. With an early rain delay, they took a tour of the lodge and learned about its long standing family history before hitting the water for some redfish.
Video.title: "Cajun Vista"

Video.summary: When Plan A and Plan B don't go as planned, Destin always has a way of bailing you out.
Video.title: "Beach Bros"

Video.summary: Mark Peterson is in the final stretch of completing the South America Upland Slam. Having already checked off nine species in Argentina, he now finds himself in Peru, where he faces the challenge of tracking down two elusive species to complete his list: the Andean Tinamou and the Western Peruvian Dove.
Video.title: "South America Upland Slam - Peru"

Video.summary: Larken and Michael set out on a Florida Man adventure in part 1 of this 2 part series. Join them in the Florida keys and Everglades for an experience that few get to experience.
Video.title: "The Chikee"

Video.summary: On this episode and adventure, we travel to Williston North Dakota for the Williston Fire Fighter fishing tournament that helps support their rural volunteer fire department. The conditions were TOUGH on Lake Sakakawea!! We learn about the Volunteer fire department and the sacrifice it takes to be there for the community. We also highlight our next SCHEELS Hometown Hero, Jim Moe! Click PLAY and check out the good things happening in North Dakota!
Video.title: "Fishing With The Williston Fire Fighters"

Video.summary: On this episode, we travel to NW Iowa and join forces with the Iowa Great lakes Fishing club to take some deserving local Veterans out fishing. This area has some amazing fisheries and we set out to prove all that true! We also highlight our next SCHEELS hometown hero, Tyler Hicks of the Rudd Fire department...Click PLAY and join us in celebrating our nations servicemen and women!
Video.title: "Iowa Great Lakes Fishing Club"

Video.summary: U.S. Marine Jake Naylor recounts his harrowing service as an EOD tech in Afghanistan.
Video.title: "Jake Naylor"

Video.summary: Vietnam war veteran Tim Smith recounts his time in Vietnam and surviving a direct hit by a missile.
Video.title: "Tim Smith"

Video.summary: Four strutters have been located and Mark has a plan to slip into the ideal position to call them in. He's decided to hunt with his son's .410 loaded with Turkey Ninja TSS.
Video.title: "A STORM IS COMING"

Video.summary: Mike and Dylan are hunting gobblers after a good rain in Alabama. Mike talks about new technology and "instamatic" cameras and gives us a spot on Dave Owens impression. He's got his .410 loaded with Apex Turkey Ninja TSS and gets a little excited when this turkey tops the ridge. Another gobbler in the coffin.
Video.title: "IMPRESSIONS, TECHNOLOGY AND DEAD TURKEYS"

Video.summary: Billy Yargus and Mark Scroggins are headed to Michigan to hunt big Eastern gobblers. Billy has a good conversation with some hens and convinces a group of long beards to join the party. Mark hunts hard for the next couple of days and finally calls a loud mouth gobbler in through the timber.
Video.title: "ROAD TRIP"

Video.summary: Mark Scroggins and his family are in Oklahoma and spot a big gobbler from the road. They are pretty sure they can get in position to call him in but they have to be quick without being seen. His step-daughter Destiny is behind the trigger and Mark just about puts this ol gobbler in her lap!
Video.title: "HEART ATTACK TURKEY HUNT"

Video.summary: After purchasing his very first Kansas farm, Shawn and his good friend Cole set out to transform it into a true whitetail paradise. Years of hard work, dedication, and habitat improvement finally pay off when Shawn takes on a challenge he’s never faced before—harvesting a whitetail buck on the ground with no blind! Filming adds another layer of difficulty, but the reward is more than worth it. In an unforgettable hunt, Shawn is able to harvest a giant 9.5-year-old Kansas buck, making this a once-in-a-lifetime experience.
Video.title: "Chasing Kansas Giants"

Video.summary: Capt Mike meets up with Leiza Fitzgerald and Jimmy Huddleston for a star tournament redfish tag mission.
Video.title: "Ozona Tag Team"

Video.summary: Long time friends Mike and Danny find a hot top water bite.
Video.title: "Horseshoe Beach"

Video.summary: Josh takes his friend Isaiah to the blue water as they look for destin's latest hot bite, the blackfin tuna.
Video.title: "Tuna Tataki"

Video.summary: Josh and George from Two Georges Marina battle the wind and tide on a tough day of fishing which leads Josh to fish another day, solely for revenge on the Sheepshead!
Video.title: "Two Georges Marina"

Video.summary: Join Captain Josh and Sheriff Eric Aden for a day of fishing and fun in Destin, Florida. These two friends hit the water, catching fish both offshore and inshore, and reeling in some impressive catches. With plenty of laughs, great stories, and a few surprises along the way, this episode is all about the joy of fishing and the bond between two guys who love the sea.
Video.title: "Hook, Line & Sheriff"

Video.summary: Join the Mayor of Destin as he ventures into the world of coastal fishing, leaving the city behind for a day of fun and unexpected challenges. With plenty of laughs and surprising twists, this episode showcases the Mayor in a whole new light.
Video.title: "Reel Politics"

Video.summary: In this episode of going coastal, Capt. Joshua Calhoon & Marcus Castro set out for epic Tarpon fishing. They got one boat side and then decided to go after giant mangrove snapper for hook & cook at Pepper’s!
Video.title: "Tarponist"

Video.summary: In this episode of Flats Class, CA travels to Venice, Louisiana to chase monster redfish on the flats with local expert Capt. Eric Newman.
Video.title: "Jumbo-laya"

Video.summary: Captain C.A. Richardson meets up with José Chavez in Pasco County to put a new Z-Man lure—designed by José himself—to the test ahead of ICAST.
Video.title: "The Lure Mechanic"

Video.summary: Captain C.A. Richardson and Captain Tyler Carner find consistent action on Sanibel Island, highlighted by doubling up on redfish.
Video.title: "Doubled Up"

Video.summary: Down in Everglades City, C.A. teams up with Capt. Chris Wittman for a day of inshore fishing and a powerful look at the mission behind Captains for Clean Water.
Video.title: "Out of Office"

Video.summary: Captain Jonathan Moss is in Columbia, South Carolina, fishing with Captain Justin McGrady for the elusive freshwater Striped Bass.
Video.title: "Reelin' Rapids"

Video.summary: Captains Jonathan Moss and Josh Greer are fishing for south Florida’s exotics amongst the alligators of the Florida Everglades.
Video.title: "Alligator Alley"

Video.summary: Captain Jonathan Moss shares the skiff with the creator of D.O.A. Lures, Capt. Mark Nichols, in Stuart, Florida.
Video.title: “Mr. D.O.A.”

Video.summary: Captain Jonathan Moss is fishing one of his favorite Central Florida Lakes for Largemouth Bass!
Video.title: “Notorious L.M.B..”

Video.summary: This episode we make our way through Florida, where we stop in Jacksonville, Jupiter, Boca Raton and Miami!!
Video.title: "We Spent 14 Days Fly Fishing Florida"

Video.summary: This episode we make our way through Florida, where we stop in Key West, Marathon, Bonita Springs, and Sanibel Island.
Video.title: "Pursuing the Fabled Grand Slam (Florida PT 2)"

Video.summary: With the fall of the Soviet Union, wildlife populations in Tajikistan were devastated, bringing some of their unique mountain species to the brink of extinction. With the help of funds generated through hunting, vast areas are now being conserved and protected. Dan Cabela explores this conservation success.
Video.title: "Tajikistan, a Mountainous Land"

Video.summary: This Montana Wall Tent Turkey hunt has been happening for over 10 years. The cast of characters has slightly changed year to year, but the core group has pretty much stayed the same. Often it has been non-traditional tactics that got birds killed and this year was no exception for Willi.
Video.title: "Montana Wall Tent Spot Stalk Turkey"

Video.summary: Welcome to spring gobbler season. Join us as Gavin heads to his home state of New York to chase gobblers on familiar ground with familiar faces.
Video.title: The - "Hunting With Dad OPENING DAY | NEW YORK Turkey Hunting"

Video.summary: In this episode, Mark Peterson finds himself deep in the heart of Peru and focuses on completing the prestigious South America Upland Slam. With only one bird remaining, the Western Peruvian Dove, the trip has led him to a private hunting property. This final challenge will take place over a cut cornfield, a favorite spot for the doves. To blend in, Mark and his team craft a makeshift blind using a mix of corn stalks, and timber, just enough cover while allowing for a clear shot. These West Peruvian Doves are known for their erratic flight patterns, often bouncing from one tree to another in a random manner, making timing and placement critical.
Video.title: "South America Upland Slam - Peru Part 2"

Video.summary: The hunt for FREAK SHOW became a thrilling adventure after I spotted him on Cabela’s trail cam. Having hunted Kentucky for over a decade and established my own properties—Bootleggers Ridge and Stonewall Plantation—I was eager for the chance at such a remarkable deer. Despite having drawn a coveted caribou tag through Worldwide Trophy Adventures’ TAGS Program, the allure of FREAK SHOW was too strong to resist. After careful planning and waiting for the right wind, I finally - set out on September 11. With my crossbow in hand, I waited anxiously in the stand, my heart racing as the shadows lengthened. Just when I thought the evening might end without a sighting, a movement caught my eye, sending my pulse soaring. With caution, FREAK SHOW appeared.
Video.title: "Freak Show - Largest Buck I’ve Ever Encountered"

Image.alt: "Freak Show - Largest Buck I’ve Ever Encountered"
"Freak Show - Largest Buck I’ve Ever Encountered"

Video.summary: Kyle and Jeff scour the rugged mountains of southern Arizona in search of the elusive Coues deer, known to hunters as the “Grey Ghost.” Through scorching sun and shifting winds, they test their skill and patience chasing one of North America’s most elusive big game animals.
Video.title: "Arizona Coues Deer"

Video.summary: Kyle Green meets up with some friends at the Idaho Fish and Game Department to ice fish for cutthroat trout. Looking to test the results of previous restocking efforts, they'll be heading to some of the most remote lakes in the state only accessible by snowmobile.
Video.title: "Remote Mountain Ice Fishing"

Video.summary: Kyle Green and Jeff Hutchinson head to Northern Maine to hunt for moose and learn about the conservation of this species which is under attack by winter ticks. Can reducing moose numbers be the key to saving the local moose population from this deadly parasite?
Video.title: "The Maine Moose"

Video.summary: Kyle Green is joined by his childhood friends in his home state of Michigan for a trout fishing adventure. They visit the most dynamic landmarks in the Upper Peninsula, do a little cliff jumping, and finish out the trip cooking trout riverside.
Video.title: "Upper Peninsula Trout Adventures"

Video.summary: Kyle and Jeff dive into the wild waters off Hawaii’s coast, coming face-to-face with sharks and graceful manta rays. The adrenaline peaks when Kyle takes a heart-pounding leap off a towering 40-foot cliff, making this adventure as daring as it is unforgettable.
Video.title: "Fishing Hawaii"

Video.summary: Captains Tom Rowland and Rich Tudor are joined by Captain Tony Young for a day of offshore fishing and free diving out of Islamorada.
Video.title: "Islamorada Offshore With Capt. Tony Young"

Video.summary: Michael and Larken head to South Texas in search of trophy-sized trout. Along the way they make a pitstop to gear up and custom-build a Texas wading rod.
Video.title: "Double or Nothin'"

Video.summary: Hop in the float plane—a new episode of DIRT just dropped. The DIRT crew made their way to Alaska, “the land of earth, sea, and sky.” All feast, no sleep is the name of the game as Josh makes the most of Alaska’s abundant and legendary daylight alongside local guides, fishermen, and even a couple grizzlies. There’ll be plenty of time to hibernate in winter. But for now—join us—there are halibut to filet, rainforest ’shrooms to forage, and mountainside meals to cook up.
Video.title: DIRT - "Alaskan Fishing, Foraging, & Mountainside Cooking with Local Legends"

Video.summary: On this show we highlight some of the best diving in the lower Keys. From the wreck of the Vandenberg too the beautiful reefs in Key West, this show has it all.
Video.title: "Big Pine Key and Key West"

Video.summary: In this inaugural episode, host Ryan McVinney takes viewers to the outer reaches of Cape Cod, Massachusetts to meet a local group of boaters affectionately referred to as the “The Tin Boat Mafia”. This heart-warming family story of aluminum boat owners who share a love for the outdoors and nature is particularly moving during the COVID-19 pandemic. From fishing and surfing to sun bathing and collecting driftwood, this episode chronicles the group’s passion for the water and demonstrates why light-weight, easy-to-handle, shallow draft aluminum fishing boats are their vessels of choice for navigating the sandbars of Cape Cod, MA.
Video.title: "Tin Boat Mafia, Cape Cod"

Video.summary: Massive wildfires had consumed thousands of acres across the Bighorn Mountains and the neighboring foothills. Would the annual HuntStand pronghorn camp be a total bust, or would the crew be able to find a few animals beyond the smoke?
Video.title: HuntStand Presents - "BEYOND THE SMOKE"

Video.summary: Join Mark Peterson as he embarks on a thrilling hunt in Croatia for the Eurasian Brown Bear. Experience the beauty of the Croatian wilderness and witness the skill and precision required for a successful hunt. Follow along as Mark faces all the challenges dealing with wind and a big bear that is extremely smart, making it very difficult to harvest this amazing animal. Don’t miss this exciting hunting adventure with Mark Peterson in Croatia!
Video.title: "Hunting Giant Eurasian Brown Bear in Croatia"

Video.summary: Welcome to Season 2 of Turkey Ninja presented by WoodHaven! It's opening day of youth season in Alabama and Mike and Jacob are ready to work on some longbeards! Right off the roost turkeys are in sight and put on quite a show for Jacob who is trying to punch a tag on his 39th "Shrutter"!
